headline: Agent harness reliability and agentic evaluation advance; CI/scan and observability changes QA teams must act on

top_signal.title: The Agent Harness: Control Planes, Invariants, and Approval Boundaries for Production AI Agents
top_signal.summary: Vinoth Govindarajan (OpenAI) explains common production-agent failures and prescribes harness controls: single-owner state, ordered commits, scoped execution, and provable receipts to avoid silent, unrecoverable state losses.
top_signal.why_it_matters: QA leads must validate harness invariants (state ownership, ordering, receipts) and add tests that detect silent state-losses standard model benchmarks miss.

items.title: GitHub deprecates all-platform CodeQL bundle
items.summary: GitHub marked the all-platform CodeQL bundle deprecated in CodeQL CLI 2.27.0 and will remove it in mid‑March 2027; teams must switch to platform-specific downloads (including ARM64) before removal.
items.why_it_matters: Automation that fetches the all-platform bundle will break CI code-scanning; update pipeline scripts, installers, and artifact mirrors to avoid scan failures.

items.title: Sentry adds zero-config Agent Tracing for Laravel AI
items.summary: Sentry shipped a laravel integration (sentry-laravel 4.27) that auto-instruments Laravel AI: it matches LLM HTTP requests to agent tool calls and surfaces conversations, tool inputs/outputs, and trace evidence in Explore.
items.why_it_matters: Makes failure triage, tool-call debugging, and E2E agent test evidence collection straightforward for PHP apps — useful for flaky-agent analysis and regression investigations.

items.title: Microsoft: 'Knowledge cutoff is a poor proxy for model capability'
items.summary: Microsoft research shows a model's stated knowledge-cutoff date does not reliably indicate what it actually knows about a product; results vary by task and version, producing mixed passes and failures.
items.why_it_matters: QA teams validating agents should create representative task suites and controlled baselines rather than relying on cutoff dates to decide what to test or provide as context.

items.title: OpenCodeReview: deterministic, agent-based AI code review (paper + OSS)
items.summary: Alibaba's OpenCodeReview (paper + open-source) describes a deterministic pipeline for agent-based code review that injects determinism at key pipeline points to make reviews reproducible and auditable.
items.why_it_matters: Deterministic review pipelines help QA make LLM-driven code-review outputs testable, reproducible, and suitable for gating and audit trails in automated workflows.

learning.title: How to Evaluate AI Agents — from tool calls to task completion
learning.summary: NVIDIA outlines layered agent evaluation: step-level traces, tool-call accuracy, task-success metrics, and harness requirements (real execution, replayable traces, and labeled evidence) for reproducible agent evals.
learning.why_it_matters: Provides practical metrics and harness patterns QA teams can adopt to build reproducible agent evaluations, detect state drift, and measure trajectory efficiency.
